$comment: Container images used to generate goldens. Pinned by multi-arch index digest; glibc only. Debian 13 moved zones like CET and EST5EDT to tzdata-legacy, so install it to match the other images. The last entry is the reference version the tests assert against.

images.name: debian:bookworm
images.install: apt-get -qq update && apt-get -qq install -y --no-install-recommends systemd tzdata

images.name: debian:trixie
images.install: apt-get -qq update && apt-get -qq install -y --no-install-recommends systemd tzdata tzdata-legacy
